color.$description: Obsidian theme-private palette. Resolved at build time and never emitted as CSS custom properties. The surfaces are warm near-black obsidian, the text is warm ivory, and the metal is 24K gold (#D4AF37) used as a scarce signal.

ink.$description: Warm near-black ramp. 950 is the page canvas; 900/800/700 are the raised, elevated and interactive surfaces; 600-300 are borders and de-emphasized text steps. Never pure #000000.

gold.$description: 24K gold ramp. 500 is the solid brand fill and primary action; 400 is emphasis text and hover; 300 is the focus ring and gold text on tinted surfaces; 600 is the pressed state and gradient shadow.

ivory.$description: Warm text colors. 100 is the primary content color; 50 is a slightly brighter heading tone added so `fg-strong` keeps a visible step above body copy. Never pure white.

claret.$description: Deep warm claret for the destructive solid fill. The source design system defines danger as text only; this fill is derived from it so destructive buttons keep WCAG AA with warm ivory text.

steel.$description: Desaturated steel blue for the informational solid fill. Derived for the same reason as claret: the core contract needs an `info-solid` surface and the source document only defines the info text color.

status.$description: Status text roles from the source design system: success, warning, danger and info. These are AA against the obsidian canvas.
